name: midway align and average T1w
summary: Aligns two T1-weighted images of the same subject into a midway space with FSL flirt and averages them into a single higher-SNR T1w image.
description: Reorients both images, optionally bias-corrects and skull-strips them to weight the registration, registers each to the other with FSL flirt, places both in a halfway space and averages them, reslicing to the resolution of the first image. Use it when a subject has repeated anatomical acquisitions; check the result visually, as the README recommends.

inputs.description: First T1-weighted image; its resolution is used for the averaged output.
Second T1-weighted image of the same subject.

outputs.description: average of inputs, reslices to resolution of image1
